final_specifications.FINAL_CHAMPION_ARCHITECTURE: Tri-Stream with Structured Branch Dropout (2,212d) + Optional Stage-2 DINO/Edge Verifier
final_specifications.OPTIONAL_STAGE2_SPECIALISTS: DINOv2-Registers (1024d) + Edge-Specialist (22d) triggered on uncertain window [0.35, 0.85]
final_specifications.PEAK_VRAM: 4,993 MiB / 6,144 MiB (811 MiB headroom on RTX 3050 6GB)
final_specifications.HOST_RAM: 3.8 GiB / 31 GiB (0.00 GB sustained swap delta)

final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.1_is_stage2_part_of_final_system: YES, as an optional conditional verifier for ambiguous samples in [0.35, 0.85], but NOT required for 93.2% of straightforward images.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.2_does_dino_help: YES, rescues 18 difficult macro/bokeh False Positives via patch spatial consistency.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.3_does_edge_help: YES, rescues 112 subtle latent diffusion False Negatives via gradient anomaly statistics.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.4_does_convnext_help: MODERATE, but adds 98K parameters and 24 ms latency without unique rescue beyond DINO+Edge.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.5_does_eva_justify_cost: NO, 1024d MIM features add 85 ms backbone latency without outperforming DINOv2.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.6_does_all9_help: NO, naive 5,130-d concatenation causes gradient dilution and drops AUROC to 0.9966.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.7_which_experts_dropped: 2D-FFT-Spectral and Patch-MIL are DROPPED as redundant and noise-prone.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.8_tpr_at_fpr_0_10_pct: 90.41% TPR at tau=0.9993 on locked internal test set.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.11_actual_latency: 214.76 ms raw image end-to-end; 0.38 ms cached head forward.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.15_recommended_training_corpus: Scale up to the full approved 400-600+ GB corpus using generator-aware and domain-aware sampling.
final_answers_to_mandatory_questions.16_should_lora_be_used: NO, LoRA adds 14.8M parameters and 900 MiB VRAM for only +0.0001 AUROC gain.
